summary: Alert component for displaying notification messages with different types (success, warning, error, info), variants (default, outlined), and dismissible functionality
Badge component for displaying notification counts or status indicators with variants (empty, default, outlined) and different types (default, info, success, warning, error)
Button component with multiple variants (outlined, default, link), types (info, success, warning, error), shapes (pill, curve, flat), sizes, and icon support
Chip component for displaying tags or labels with dismissible functionality, different variants (outlined, default), shapes, and sizes
Dialog component for displaying confirmation dialogs with customizable title, text, action buttons, and positioning options
Modal component for displaying overlay content with different sizes (tight, compact, base, wide, full) and shapes (curve, flat, pill)
Toast notification component with draggable dismiss functionality, action buttons, and positioning options (top, bottom variants)
Tooltip component for displaying contextual information on hover or focus
Tooltip content component that renders the actual tooltip content within the tooltip system
Tooltip handler component that manages tooltip positioning and visibility logic
Accordion group component that serves as a container for multiple accordion items
Individual accordion item component that can be expanded or collapsed within an accordion group
Accordion header component that serves as the clickable trigger to expand/collapse accordion content with icon options (chevron, plus)
Accordion content component that contains the collapsible content within an accordion item
Dropdown container component that manages dropdown menu positioning and visibility with flexible positioning options
Dropdown trigger component that serves as the clickable element to open/close dropdown menus
Dropdown menu container component that holds dropdown menu items and groups
Dropdown menu group component for organizing related dropdown menu items together
Individual dropdown menu item component that represents a clickable option in the dropdown menu
Dropdown menu label component for displaying section headers within dropdown menus
Dropdown menu shortcut component for displaying keyboard shortcuts next to menu items
Dropdown separator component for adding visual dividers between dropdown menu sections
Dropdown menu portal component for creating nested dropdown submenus with portal-based rendering
Dropdown submenu component that contains submenu items within a dropdown portal
Dropdown submenu trigger component that opens nested submenus within dropdown menus
Input form control component with support for different input types (text, password, email, etc.), icons, validation, and accessibility features
Textarea form control component with auto-resize functionality, validation support, and customizable shapes and help text
Select dropdown form control component with single/multi-select support, search functionality, custom templates, and accessibility features
Checkbox form control component with different shapes (curve, flat), sizes, label positioning, and validation support
Radio button group form control component with horizontal/vertical layout options and validation support
Toggle switch form control component for boolean values with label and help text support
Date picker form control component with single/range selection, calendar dropdown, date formatting, validation, and responsive breakpoints
Calendar component used within the date picker for rendering the calendar grid and date selection logic
Calendar select component for month/year selection within the date picker calendar
Required indicator component that displays a visual indicator (typically asterisk) for required form fields
Validation error component for displaying form validation error messages below form controls
